notes: DUO-3222 (version-pinned adapter compatibility contract): plugin/version_range verified live (not guessed) — advanced-custom-fields/acf.php, ACF 6.8.7 installed fresh from wp.org this session. Range is deliberately scoped to the CURRENT major version line only (6.x, [6.0.0, 7.0.0)) — this issue's own non-goal is 'does not certify individual plugins,' so widening the range to also cover past major versions (5.x) is DUO-3224's ratification job against real evidence, not invented here without it.

DUO-3263: options_/_options_ claims ACF's options-page field storage (free plugin, no PRO required — acf_add_options_page() itself is PRO-only, but update_field()/get_field() with post_id 'option'/'options' persists via the same object-type value API regardless, empirically confirmed against fresh ACF 6.8.7: options_<field>=value, _options_<field>=shadow pointer to field_<key>, both rows removed atomically by delete_field()). Per-key ref resolution is dynamic (Acf::option_rule(), same field-definition/rule_for_type() machinery post_meta_rule()/term_meta_rule() already use) — this namespace claim only grants OWNERSHIP so Capture's namespace-owned-option path asks the interpreter at all; it does not itself classify anything.
